heading: INT. FLOODED COUNTY COURTHOUSE - MAKESHIFT COURTROOM - DAY

units.text: INT. FLOODED COUNTY COURTHOUSE - MAKESHIFT COURTROOM - DAY
Sandbags by the doors.
Folding tables.
A generator hums.
JUDGE OLUWASEUN ADEYEMI, 60s, presides from a card table.
DISTRICT ATTORNEY RHONDA KESSLER, 40s, stands with a soggy file.
PUBLIC DEFENDER MARCUS TIBBS, 30s, trouser cuffs wet.
The defendant, WALTER "SKEETER" DUVAL, 50s, sits in rubber boots.
COURT CLERK PENNY FARRELL, 20s, types on a laptop on a milk crate.
BAILIFF GUS OKAFOR, 50s, leans on the doorframe.
Be seated. We'll proceed on the record, such as it is.
units.name: JUDGE ADEYEMI

units.text: Your Honor, the State requests a continuance. Half our exhibits are under four feet of river.
units.name: RHONDA

units.text: Defense objects. My client has waited eleven months. He can't wait another flood season.
units.name: MARCUS

units.text: Mr. Tibbs, your client is charged with stealing a boat.
units.name: JUDGE ADEYEMI

units.text: Borrowing, Your Honor. And that boat is the only reason forty people made it off Pratt Street last night.
units.name: MARCUS

units.text: Forty people who would not have needed rescuing if he hadn't taken the boat from the marina in the first place.
units.name: RHONDA

units.text: That is a logical pretzel.
units.name: MARCUS

units.text: Can I say something?
units.name: SKEETER

units.text: No.
units.name: MARCUS

units.text: Let him.
units.name: JUDGE ADEYEMI

units.text: I'd do it again, Judge. Ain't proud, ain't sorry.
units.name: SKEETER

units.text: Your Honor, that's practically a confession.
units.name: RHONDA

units.text: It's practically a sermon. Ms. Kessler, do you still wish to prosecute?
units.name: JUDGE ADEYEMI

units.text: The State will reduce to trespass.
units.name: RHONDA

units.text: Time served.
units.name: MARCUS

units.text: Time served. Mr. Duval, return the boat with a thank-you note.
units.name: JUDGE ADEYEMI

units.text: Yes, ma'am.
units.name: SKEETER

units.text: Court is adjourned. Mind the step.
units.name: JUDGE ADEYEMI
